I've written `WORK_INSTRUCTIONS.md` for unit 439, aimed at criterion 7.4 as the redirect requires. I only wrote that one file.

**The route.** The unit will change how the unit estimator handles very short silences inside a mark. `CwUnitEstimator.Runs` (`src/Hamlet.RadioEngine/Cw/CwUnitEstimator.cs:491`) ignores a silence shorter than 2 hops (10 ms), but still ends the mark there. So one mark gets recorded as two short ones. A 10 or 15 ms silence is also recorded as a gap. Unit 436 found the opening's marks broken into 19 to 34 ms pieces with 10 to 15 ms gaps, where the sender's dit is 55 ms.

The top of the speed search is 40 WPM, which is a 30 ms dit, so no sender in range keys a gap of 15 ms or less. The change joins any silence up to half that dit (15 ms, 3 hops) into the marks on both sides. It applies in `Measure` only, and the limit is written from `FastestWpm`, so raising the top speed under 7.1 shrinks it automatically. The cut level, the clustering, the stream, the mixdown and `CwToneTracker` are untouched. The tracker stays off-limits until 4.1 is met (R76).

**How the unit runs:**
- **Trace first:** it replays the change offline on the opening, on a stretch where the decoder already reads well, and on 003901 and 003919 from a cold start.
- **Stop rule, fixed in advance:** nothing is built if, from 34.5 to 44.5 s, the new unit stays under 40 ms on every read, or if every read from 30 to 46.2 s produces the same characters as now.
- **Judging:** a build must pass 3.2's four tests. The opening's text must also change, or the change comes back out.
- **One fallback:** a 10 ms version, built only if the first fails on exactly one recording or one test.

**Loop test:** the approach appears in no earlier attempt. The closest are unit 436, which picked a different group of marks as the dit, and unit 438, which moved the on/off threshold. Neither changed what a silence too short to be keying does to a mark.

**Decisions I made on my own authority (you can overrule):**
- The 15 ms limit, the scope and the stop rule.
- I did not follow unit 438's proposal to hold 7.4 until 4.7. The redirect requires 7.4, and this route doesn't depend on the tracker.
- The launcher-overlap question is still yours. I passed it forward without ruling on it.

Separately, three Claude connectors (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive) need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings. They can't be used until then, and this unit doesn't need them.
